properties.name: ALBERGUE ZARAGOZA HOSTEL
properties.address: C. de los Predicadores, 70, Casco Antiguo, 50003 Zaragoza
properties.info: Albergue Zaragoza Hostel is in a medieval building in the old town of Zaragoza, at Calle de los Predicadores 70, a few steps from the River Ebro and close to the Basílica del Pilar, with the cathedral of La Seo and the Aljafería palace within easy walking distance. Rooms have air conditioning, heating and, according to its online listing, a balcony looking over the historic centre. Options range from a bed in a shared bunk room to double rooms and a family room for two adults and a child, all with shared bathrooms. There is a lift, a terrace, a picnic area, free Wi-Fi, lockers at no extra charge and a 24-hour reception that hands out free maps and tourist information. The basement is used for art exhibitions and film screenings. Review scores on its booking page are highest for staff, at 8.8 out of 10.

properties.name: ALBERGUE-HOSTEL "LAS ESCUELAS"
properties.address: Ctra. Ambel, 4, 50546 Bulbuente, Zaragoza
properties.info: Albergue-Hostel Las Escuelas is the municipal albergue of Bulbuente, a small village in the Campo de Borja area of Zaragoza province, housed in the restored old village schoolhouse, a few minutes from the Moncayo Natural Park. It offers private rooms and, for groups, rental of the whole building: a double room for one or two people with a private bathroom and bed linen included, and rooms for families or groups of friends with a camping-style private bathroom. There is a large garden with a barbecue, private parking and heating and cooling. It has no kitchen: there is only a dining room with a fridge, microwave and coffee machine, and no crockery or utensils, so plan to eat out or bring your own. The albergue is a partner of the Garnacha Wine Route and can help with winery visits and restaurant suggestions. It also manages a rural house in the village, Cuenta la Leyenda, sleeping ten. It promotes itself for walking trips, group getaways and quiet breaks.

properties.name: GRAMPY BOUTIQUE HOSTAL
properties.address: C. de los Predicadores, 80, Casco Antiguo, 50003 Zaragoza
properties.info: Grampy Boutique Hostal is a small guesthouse at Calle de los Predicadores 80 in El Gancho, the historic old quarter of Zaragoza, near the remains of the Roman wall. Its booking-site listings describe standard double rooms and family rooms with air conditioning, private bathrooms, free Wi-Fi, a TV, a wardrobe and a sofa, and its Airbnb listing says it aims to give guests calm and exclusivity. The Roman Forum and the Plaza de España are about 12 minutes away on foot and the Basílica del Pilar is roughly 800 metres away. Check-in is from 15:00 to 23:00, and after-hours check-in is not available. Check-out is at 11:00, the property is smoke-free, pets are not allowed and there is no parking. Guests rate it around 9 out of 10 on the booking sites that list it.

properties.name: HOTEL AVENIDA
properties.address: Av. de César Augusto, 55, Casco Antiguo, 50003 Zaragoza
properties.info: Hotel Avenida is a boutique hotel, not a hostel, at Avenida César Augusto 55 in the centre of Zaragoza, in a converted building from the late eighteenth century opposite the Central Market. It describes itself as an oasis of calm for lovers of nature, art and design, with rooms and lounges full of plants and craft pieces, and it calls itself an eco-friendly hotel. The Plaza de España is three minutes away on foot and the Basilica del Pilar and La Seo four, while the high-speed AVE station is four minutes by car, with Madrid or Barcelona about an hour and a quarter away, and a tram stops at the door. Rooms range from superior doubles to premium suites. Guests get free Wi-Fi, air conditioning and covered parking, and the building is accessible. It also hires out meeting rooms and event spaces. It suits travellers who want a comfortable private room in the old centre rather than a dorm bed.

properties.name: ALBERGUE ALBARRACÍN
properties.address: C. Sta. María, 5, 44100 Albarracín, Teruel
properties.info: Albergue Albarracín is a hostel in a manor house more than a hundred years old, hanging on a hillside in the historic centre of Albarracín, a medieval town of red-brown façades, cobbled lanes and old walls. Its site says the views from every window take in the town, the wall and the Guadalaviar river. It has 76 beds in rooms of four or six in bunks with shared bathrooms, and wood-beamed six-bed rooms look onto the walls and river. A simple dining room serves a free breakfast and prepares packed lunches, and half and full board are available for groups. Free Wi-Fi covers the building. The cathedral, the Moorish castle and the diocesan museum are one to two minutes on foot, the river walk three and the walls about six to seven, and the Rodeno pine landscape is a short trip away. It suits small groups, families, school trips and solo travellers, and the hostel stands on a quiet cobbled street 33 km from the A23.

properties.name: ALBERGUE EL RIO
properties.address: C. Cta. Postigo, 1, 44370 Cella, Teruel
properties.info: Albergue El Río is a modern albergue in the town of Cella in Teruel province, on the route between Teruel and Albarracín and close to the Fuente de Cella spring, a local attraction. Its specialty is groups, such as camps, sports camps, school trips and pre-season training, though couples and friends are also welcome, and it offers both shared and private rooms, some with private bathrooms. It has a lift, heating, a terrace, an indoor kitchen with microwave, dishwasher, washing machine and freezer, free Wi-Fi, a projector for the common area, board games and a bike store with a pump and repair stand. It is adapted for guests with reduced mobility, accepts cards and Bizum, and does not allow pets. Breakfast can be served for groups of 20 or more. A supermarket, bars and a restaurant are within three minutes on foot, and the town has a health centre, a heated pool and padel courts. The albergue stamps the Camino del Cid pilgrim passport.

properties.name: ALBERGUE LA ESTACIÓN
properties.address: C. Román Romano, 15, 33500 Llanes, Asturias
properties.info: Albergue La Estación occupies the old FEVE railway station buildings in the town of Llanes, on the Camino de Santiago del Norte. It is a privately run albergue, classed as first category under Asturian tourist-hostel rules, so you do not need a pilgrim's credential to stay. Guests have use of a kitchen with a ceramic hob and oven, a washing machine, a tumble dryer and free Wi-Fi. Llanes is a municipality of tourist excellence with more than 30 beaches, about 40 km from the Picos de Europa National Park and 30 km from the Sella and Cares-Deva salmon rivers. That makes it a handy base for hiking, kayaking, canyoning, climbing and mountain biking as well as a stop for pilgrims. The albergue's website mentions a March to October season, so check opening dates before you travel. The Booking.com and Hostelworld listings have photos and reviews.

properties.name: BOOGALOW HOSTEL
properties.address: C. Jovellanos, 1, Centro, 33202 Gijón, Asturias
properties.info: Boogalow is a mini hostel in the centre of Gijón, directly opposite the beach, with just seven rooms, each one different. The view is what guests value most: you wake up looking over the sea, the beach and the old town. There are two shared spaces, a fully equipped kitchen and a lounge with games and books, plus free coffee, hot chocolate and herbal tea all day, a washing machine and a dryer. Sheets, towels, shampoo and shower gel, ear plugs and fast Wi-Fi are provided, and the hostel has a paddle-surf board, a bodyboard and skateboards. The atmosphere is described as quiet, mixed and respectful, so expect several languages and the odd child's laugh. In high season reception is staffed until 17:00; at other times check-in is handled online and the latest arrival is 21:00. Shops, restaurants and nightlife are close by.

properties.name: GIJÓN SURF HOSTEL
properties.address: Cam. de las Higueras, 62, Periurbano - Rural, 33203 Gijón, Asturias
properties.info: Gijón Surf Hostel is a surf-themed hostel on Camino de las Higueras, around 150 to 200 metres from El Rinconín beach, separated from the sand by a green area. It doubles as an official surf school, so surf and paddle-surf lessons are on offer and boards and snorkelling equipment can be hired on site. Guests share a kitchen and a lounge, and there is a garden with barbecue facilities, free Wi-Fi, free parking, table tennis, billiards, darts and bike hire. It is registered as a first-category tourist hostel with 12 beds, which keeps it small and sociable. It is also listed by the regional tourism board for walkers on the Camino de la Costa, with secure bike storage and public transport within 500 metres. Hostelworld guests score it 9.0 from 173 reviews, and Booking.com reviewers mention the friendly community, daily cleaning and fun lessons.

properties.name: GREEN HOSTEL
properties.address: C. Magdalena, 3, 2º izquierda, 33009 Oviedo, Asturias
properties.info: Green Hostel is a modern, sustainability-minded hostel in the historic centre of Oviedo, on Calle Magdalena next to the Plaza del Ayuntamiento. It occupies the former Hostal Arcos, which for decades was a well-known base for visitors to the city. There are shared and private rooms, a terrace and common areas designed so guests can swap stories and tips. It is registered as a first-category tourist hostel with 26 beds and is open all year, with breakfast included according to its official tourism-board listing. Heating, internet access, a washing machine and a laundry service are available and cards are accepted. The owners aim to offer extras such as guided tours, outdoor activities, cider-house tastings and bike routes, and they work to cut waste, water and electricity use. It is not pilgrim-only, but it sits on the first stage of the Camino Primitivo out of Oviedo.

properties.name: HIHOME HOSTEL
properties.address: C. Uría, 33, 1º dcha, 33003 Oviedo, Asturias
properties.info: HiHome Hostel is a small hostel on Calle Uría in the centre of Oviedo, close to Plaza de España and about a one-minute walk from the train station. It has six rooms: two doubles, two triples and two shared rooms with bunk beds, so it suits couples and small groups as well as solo travellers. Check-in runs from 14:00 until midnight and check-out is before 12:00. The staff speak Spanish, English and French. It is open all year and you do not need a pilgrim's credential to stay, which makes it a convenient stop for walkers starting or finishing the Camino Primitivo, which begins at Oviedo's cathedral. Booking ahead is advisable. Pets are not accepted. Review sites put its guest score at around 7.8 out of 10, and the Booking.com and Hostelworld listings have photos and guest reviews.

properties.name: HIHOME HOSTEL CATEDRAL
properties.address: C. San Antonio, 7, 33003 Oviedo, Asturias
properties.info: HiHome Hostel Catedral opened in 2025 on the first floor of a building at Calle San Antonio 7, in the heart of Oviedo and close to both the cathedral and the railway station. It is the second HiHome hostel in the city, sharing its website and contact details with HiHome Hostel on Calle Uría, and the staff speak Spanish, English and French. Hostelworld describes it as a modern, welcoming hostel, and a regional pilgrim directory says it has all the comforts a pilgrim might need. The cathedral is the starting point of the Camino Primitivo, so the location suits pilgrims setting out on the route, and the hostel also takes tourists and other travellers. The Booking.com and Hostelworld listings have photos and guest reviews, and as it is a new property it is worth checking the most recent ones.

properties.name: HOTEL LA CAMPANA
properties.address: AS-381, km 3, 15, 33192 Pruvia de abajo, Asturias
properties.info: Hotel La Campana is a three-star hotel at Pruvia, on the AS-18, in the middle of Asturias. Its website puts it about 13 km from Oviedo's old town, 17 km from the beaches of Gijón and 44 km from Asturias airport, with Oviedo ten minutes away by road, Gijón twelve and Avilés twenty, which makes it a practical base for exploring the region by car. Rooms are doubles with one bed or two, superior doubles and a suite. There is plenty of parking, and guests mention the quiet, clean rooms, easy access and views over the garden. Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is at 12:00, and a small meeting room has a screen and projector. This is a conventional hotel with private rooms rather than dorms, so solo budget travellers may prefer the hostels in Oviedo or Gijón.

properties.name: LA HOSPEDERÍA OVIEDO
properties.address: C. Schultz, 7, bajo, 33003 Oviedo, Asturias
properties.info: La Hospedería is a small private albergue in Oviedo's old town, on Calle Schultz, a few metres from the cathedral and at kilometre zero of the first stage of the Camino Primitivo. That makes it a natural first or last night on the route, and its website opens with the old pilgrims' saying that whoever goes to Santiago but not to El Salvador visits the servant and not the lord, a reference to Oviedo's cathedral. Guests get individual lockers with keys, a private inner courtyard for bicycles, keyless entry with an access code and online check-in. The team gives pilgrims information and help to discover the city. Booking is through Booking.com via the albergue's website, and you can also contact it directly by email or phone if you have questions. Prices vary with the season, so check the booking pages for current rates and guest reviews.

properties.info: 360 Hostel Borne is at Ronda de Sant Pere 56, beside the El Borne neighbourhood, known for arts and culture, nightlife and restaurants, and a few blocks from Plaça Catalunya, La Rambla and Passeig de Gràcia. The hostel says it was awarded best hostel in the world for solo travellers, and it combines some calm with daily activities such as walking tours, free dinners and nights out. Its rooms are described as very spacious: a two-bed room with a private terrace and dorms of six, eight and twelve beds, all with free lockers, reading lights, air conditioning and linen. There is a well-equipped kitchen and a big terrace for the Barcelona sun. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is before 11:00, with free Wi-Fi throughout. Towels can be hired and laundry costs extra. Wheelchair access is listed among its facilities, and a pub crawl runs most nights.

properties.address: Carrer de Bailèn, 7, Eixample, 08010 Barcelona
properties.info: 360 Hostel Centro is a social hostel at Carrer de Bailèn 7 in central Barcelona, a few blocks from Plaça Catalunya, La Rambla and Passeig de Gràcia, with the Old Town next door and the Sagrada Família and the beach within walking distance. It has a big communal lounge with sofas and a large, fully equipped kitchen with a stove, microwave, toaster, fridge, pots and pans. Dorms sleep four, six or eight, and there is a two-bed room with its own terrace; every room has free lockers, reading lights, air conditioning and linen. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is before 11:00, and free Wi-Fi covers the building. The young staff run a free walking tour every day and a different activity each night, such as paella night, free sangria and tapas, pasta night and a pub crawl. Towels can be hired and laundry costs extra. The hostel is wheelchair accessible.

properties.name: ONEFAM BATLLÓ
properties.address: Carrer de Casanova, 52, Loc 1, Eixample, 08011 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Batlló is a cosy hostel in the Eixample, steps from Casa Batlló on Passeig de Gràcia and at the intersection of two of Barcelona's metro lines. The Sagrada Família is one stop away and the Barceloneta beach about 20 minutes on foot, which makes it a convenient base for Gaudí's modernist landmarks. The chain pitches it as a home away from home for backpackers after an authentic experience, with a relaxed, social atmosphere. Guests get free Wi-Fi, a fully equipped shared kitchen and regular events to meet other travellers, including walking tours, bar crawls and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours and each bed has a locker. Check-in is from 14:00 and free luggage storage is offered on arrival and departure days. Onefam says all five of its Barcelona hostels score 9.7 to 9.8 on Hostelworld, and Batlló is one of the two at 9.8.

properties.name: ONEFAM LES CORTS
properties.address: Ptge. del Regent Mendieta, 5, Les Corts, 08028 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Les Corts is in the residential neighbourhood of Les Corts, next to Camp Nou and one metro stop from the Eixample, so it suits travellers who want a quieter base and a taste of a local Barcelona neighbourhood away from the tourist crowds. The chain says it has over 100 beds in shared and private rooms. The common lounge has a TV, a PlayStation and a pool table, and the rooftop terrace has sun loungers and tables under umbrellas. There is a strong local café scene nearby, and the hostel runs the usual Onefam social programme of walking tours, bar crawls and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00, lockers are provided and luggage can be stored free on arrival and departure days. Onefam says the hostel scores 9.7 on Hostelworld, and it offers its best rates when you book direct on the Onefam website.

properties.name: ONEFAM PARALELO
properties.address: Carrer de Salvà, 62, Sants-Montjuïc, 08004 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Paralelo is in Poble Sec, near Avinguda del Paral·lel, a lively neighbourhood of local tapas bars that is less touristy than the Old Town. Montjuïc is five minutes uphill, Las Ramblas about ten minutes on foot and the beach a 15-minute walk or one metro stop away. The chain describes it as the most social of its five Barcelona hostels, with bar crawls leaving weekly and a rooftop terrace that becomes a meeting point every evening. Guests can relax in the common areas, meet other travellers and join the usual Onefam programme of walking tours and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00, lockers are provided and luggage can be stored free on arrival and departure days. Onefam says the hostel scores 9.7 on Hostelworld. It is a good pick for travellers who want local bars, Montjuïc and the beach within easy reach.

properties.name: ONEFAM RAMBLAS HOSTEL BARCELONA
properties.address: Carrer d'Albareda, 6, Sants-Montjuïc, 08004 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Ramblas sits in the Old Town, steps from Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter and the city's main sights, with the beach, the cathedral and the harbour all within a 15-minute walk. It is one of five Onefam hostels in Barcelona, a chain that says its Barcelona hostels score 9.7 to 9.8 on Hostelworld. Guests get free high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped shared kitchen, a common lounge made for meeting other travellers, lockers and a 24-hour reception. The weekly social programme includes a free walking tour, a bar crawl and group dinners. Dorms use keycard access. Check-in is from 14:00, with earlier check-in from 10:00 on request if a room is free, and luggage can be stored free from 08:00 on arrival day. Towels can be rented. It is billed as the best base for first-timers who want to walk everywhere, and it takes bookings direct on the Onefam website.

properties.name: ONEFAM SANTS HOSTEL BARCELONA
properties.address: Carrer de Casteràs, 9, Sants-Montjuïc, 08028 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Sants stands directly beside Barcelona Sants, the city's main intercity train and bus station, which makes it a practical choice for late arrivals, early departures and day trips. Girona, Montserrat, Tarragona and the Costa Brava are all under an hour away by rail, and the city centre is three metro stops away. The hostel's selling points are a spacious rooftop terrace with panoramic views and a chill-out lounge with a pool table, and the chain describes it as a cosy, authentic place for backpackers. Guests share the usual Onefam social programme of walking tours, bar crawls and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00, lockers are provided and luggage can be stored free on arrival and departure days. Onefam says the hostel scores 9.7 on Hostelworld and that dorm beds are cheapest when booked direct on its own site.

properties.address: Carrer de Terol, 35, Gràcia, 08012 Barcelona
properties.info: Sant Jordi Hostels Gràcia is the chain's calmer, boutique hostel, at Carrer de Terol 35 in the Gràcia district, which the hostel calls the hippest neighbourhood in Barcelona, full of squares, bars, restaurants, art studios, theatres and independent shops, and well connected to the centre by metro line 3 and bus. All rooms are air conditioned mixed or female dorms for four to eight people with shared bathrooms, and each bed has a locker that needs no padlock, a reading lamp and a charging point. There is a fully equipped guest kitchen, a rooftop and an interior patio, laundry, towels, guest computers, free Wi-Fi, luggage storage, a 24-hour reception, daily cleaning and bike and skate rental. The hostel describes its atmosphere as young but calm, suited to solo travellers and small groups, and sends party seekers to its Sagrada Família hostel. Registered as AJ000535.

properties.name: SANT JORDI HOSTELS ROCK PALACE
properties.address: Carrer de Balmes, 75, Eixample, 08007 Barcelona
properties.info: Rock Palace is the rock-and-roll hostel of the Sant Jordi chain, at Carrer Balmes 75, five minutes on foot from Passeig de Gràcia and Casa Batlló and ten from Plaça Catalunya, the Gothic Quarter and La Pedrera. Its common areas are styled after the bars and clubs that shaped modern music, with a guitar collection, a famous bar and a rooftop terrace with a pool. Dorms are mixed or female, from four to fourteen beds, and many are en suite; every bed has a large locker opened by the key card, a reading lamp, a charging point and a headboard cubby, and the rooms are soundproofed and air conditioned. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi, guest computers, a guest kitchen, laundry, luggage storage and bike and skate rental. Check-in is from 14:00, check-out is until 11:00, a refundable 10 euro key-card deposit applies, and quiet hours start at 23:00. Registered as AJ000593.

properties.name: SANT JORDI HOSTELS SAGRADA FAMILIA
properties.address: Carrer del Freser, 5, Sant Martí, 08026 Barcelona
properties.info: Sant Jordi Hostels Sagrada Familia is the chain's skateboard hostel, at Carrer Freser 5, with a skating theme that reflects Barcelona's street art, urban culture and nightlife, and an indoor skate room with a mini-ramp. It is a ten-minute walk from the Sagrada Família, and two metro lines, L2 and L5, are five minutes away, with three night bus lines less than three blocks from the door. Dorms range from three to twelve beds, mixed or female, many with private bathrooms, plus a triple private room; each bed has a locker, a reading lamp and a charging point, and rooms are air conditioned. There is a large guest kitchen, a lounge, a private patio, guest computers, free Wi-Fi, laundry, luggage storage, a 24-hour reception and bike and skate rental. The hostel runs daily activities and nights out, and warns that it is a party hostel, recommending its Gràcia hostel for something mellower. Registered as AJ000517.

There are social areas where guests can relax and meet other travellers, and its own site pitches the city as a mix of surfing, local food, beach time and the Old Town. Groups are described as the hostel's speciality, so it takes bookings for large parties as well as individual travellers. It is a registered tourist business (CIE 2356) and promises the best price when you book on its own website. The site is available in English, Spanish, French and Basque. properties.info: Belle Époque is a restored guesthouse on the first floor at Alameda del Boulevard 26, in central San Sebastián. A guest on Booking.com says it is close to the sea, the city centre, shops, bars and restaurants, so you can do everything on foot, and that the host is easy to reach. It has five rooms: two triples (a double and a single bed) with shared bathroom and no outside view, a triple with a balcony overlooking the Boulevard and its old bandstand, a double with a balcony closed in by coloured stained glass, and another double with a balcony and Boulevard view. The restoration used pastel tones, warm wooden floors and white walls. Phone and WhatsApp are answered from 09:00 to 20:00, and a night watchman takes calls and WhatsApp messages outside those hours. It is registered as a tourist guesthouse (HSS00672).

properties.name: BLAI BLAI HOSTEL
properties.address: Nafarroa Kalea, 37A, 20800 Zarautz, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Blai Blai is a small family-run hostel in Zarautz, at Nafarroa 37A, with shared rooms about three minutes on foot from the beach. The owners say everyone is welcome, from young and not-so-young travellers to groups, couples, solo guests, pilgrims and surfers, and they talk up the chance for linguistic and cultural exchange between guests. Zarautz has a long beach known for surfing and sits between the ocean and the mountains, and the hostel's site recommends yoga, surf lessons and a mix of cultural, historical and food experiences nearby. The town has a motorway exit on the A-8 and a stop on the Bilbao to San Sebastián railway, with regular buses to the surrounding coast. Bookings can be made through its own site, Booking.com or Hostelworld, and a mobile number for reservations is on the site.

properties.name: CASA RURAL LA PALMERA - LANDETXEA
properties.address: Hernani Bidea, 25, 20160 Lasarte, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Casa Rural La Palmera is a country guesthouse at Hernani Bidea 25 in Lasarte-Oria, in the green belt around San Sebastián and about ten minutes from the city. It is not a hostel: it can be rented as a whole or room by room, and each room has its own en-suite bathroom, an extra-large bed, a mini fridge and a tea and coffee station. The house has more than 2,000 square metres of garden with fruit trees and its landmark palm tree, free Wi-Fi, smart TVs and a fully equipped kitchen for guests to cook in. A continental breakfast is available for an extra charge, pets are welcome on request for a fee, and there is free parking with one space per room. There is no 24-hour reception: check-in is online and rooms open with a code or by Bluetooth from your phone. Its tourist licence number is XSS00154.

properties.name: CATS HOSTEL SAN SEBASTIAN
properties.address: Heriz Pasealekua, 38, 20008 Donostia / San Sebastián, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Cats Hostel San Sebastián, formerly Koisi, is at Paseo Heriz 38, next to Ondarreta beach, and is one of four Cats hostels in Spain and Portugal. It has private and shared rooms, including female dormitories, with bunk beds and individual reading lights, plus a terrace, a bar and common areas with a kitchen and lounge. Guests praise clean bathrooms, friendly staff, a well-equipped kitchen and plenty of storage space. Check-in is from 15:00, check-out is at 11:00 and breakfast is served from 08:00 to 10:30. Pets are not allowed and under-18s cannot stay in shared rooms. There is no car park; the nearest is about a kilometre away and the streets around the hostel are a paid blue zone. The nearest metro and tram stop is Amara, about a ten-minute walk, and the hostel says it does not use WhatsApp to communicate with guests, so contact is by phone or email.

properties.name: COLO COLO HOSTEL SAN SEBASTIÁN
properties.address: Arrasate K., 3, 20005 Donostia / San Sebastián, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Colo Colo calls itself the Smart Hostel: a hostel with the privacy of a hotel, born in San Sebastián and now also in Valencia. The San Sebastián hostel is at Calle Arrasate 3, and its own site pitches the city's surf at Zurriola beach and the pintxos of the Old Town. Instead of dorm bunks it has self-contained sleeping pods called casitas, available as the standard Casita or the larger Gran Casita, equipped with tablets and fast Wi-Fi. A shared lounge gives guests somewhere to meet over coffee. The hostel promotes a local-minded stay, with partner offers at nearby businesses such as a surf school, a barre fitness studio and an art and concept store, and suggests a pintxos crawl through the Old Town. Its own site says stays start from around thirty euros a night, though prices change with season. It is registered as a tourist establishment (BSS00040) and takes bookings through its website or Booking.com and Hostelworld.

properties.name: DOWNTOWN RIVER HOSTEL
properties.address: San Martin Kalea, 2, 20005 Donostia / San Sebastián, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Downtown River Hostel is at Calle San Martín 2 in the centre of San Sebastián, a few steps from the River Urumea and under five minutes on foot from the Old Town and La Concha beach. It offers shared rooms in a social, traveller-oriented atmosphere. Each guest is assigned a locker with a lock, there is a fully equipped kitchen for guests to use, and free luggage storage is available around the clock, handy before check-in or after check-out. Surfboards and wetsuits can be rented at the hostel, and Zurriola, the city's main surf beach, is a few minutes' walk away. Reception is open 24 hours from June to October; in autumn and winter the staff message guests the day before arrival to arrange check-in. The Atotxa railway station is about ten minutes on foot, and groups can enquire by email. The hostel says booking direct on its own site is cheaper than Booking.com or Hostelworld.

properties.name: KOBA HOSTEL
properties.address: Calle Carquizano, Karkizano Kalea, 5, Bajo, 20001 Donostia / San Sebastián, Guipúzcoa
properties.info: Koba Hostel is a converted 1917 car workshop in Gros, the surf and food district of San Sebastián, at Calle Carquizano 5. The Zurriola beach is two minutes on foot, the Kursaal four, the train and bus stations eight and the Old Town ten. It has private rooms for two or three, shared rooms for six to ten with curtained bunks, an individual light and plug, a locker and a bathroom in the room, and family rooms for four or five. Every room has its own bathroom and heating and air conditioning, and breakfast is included. Guests also get Wi-Fi, a kitchen and dining room, a terrace, a lounge with a cinema corner, a store for surfboards and bikes and free luggage storage, while bikes, boards, wetsuits and towels can be rented. Reception is open 24 hours. The hostel holds Biosphere and EU Ecolabel sustainability certificates for 2024 and runs on renewable electricity.

properties.name: OFF BEAT GUESTHOUSE
properties.address: C. 31 de Agosto, 16, Planta 1, 20003 Donostia / San Sebastián, Guipúzcoa
properties.info: Off Beat Guesthouse is a small eco-minded guesthouse on the first floor at Calle 31 de Agosto 16, in the Old Town of San Sebastián, on what it calls the city's oldest street. It sells itself as original and unique, with up-cycled decoration, art projects and the slogan Sleep Conscious, and it plants one tree for every booking made on its own website. Guests on Booking.com praise the location a stone's throw from the pintxo bars and nightlife, the clean, decent-sized rooms with interesting decor, the kettle provided in the room and the friendly staff. The reception team offers tips such as joining the local pintxo contest and finding things to do in the city. Phone and WhatsApp are answered from 09:00 to 20:00. It is a registered tourist guesthouse (HSS00842) and takes bookings through its own site as well as Booking.com and Hostelworld.

properties.name: PENSION AIA
properties.address: Zabaleta Kalea, 40, 20002 Donostia / San Sebastián, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Pensión Aia is a small guesthouse on the first floor at Calle Zabaleta 40 in Gros, the pedestrian-friendly district of San Sebastián that is also home to the Zurriola surf beach. Its site gives walking times of about five minutes to the Zurriola beach and the Kursaal congress centre, and about ten minutes to the Old Town and La Concha beach. Guests on its site describe a very clean, simply and elegantly decorated place with comfortable beds, a small kitchen where you can make breakfast and an attentive owner. The bars around the pension are known for pintxos, and Gros holds its Pintxo-Pote evening on Thursdays. Several shops nearby rent surfboards and wetsuits, and the owners also run the Apartamento Royal in the same district. It is a registered tourist guesthouse (HSS00713), and the site is available in Spanish, English, Basque and French.

properties.info: Pensión Miramar is a small guesthouse at Calle Puerto 6 in the Old Town of San Sebastián, surrounded by pintxo bars. It was reopened by new owners and has just four rooms, each with a private bathroom: Ondarreta (up to three guests, ensuite, with a street balcony), Concha (up to three, with a bay window and a private sitting room), Zurriola (up to five, the largest, with two adjoining rooms and a sofa bed) and Irla (a double with a private kitchen and a balcony over an inner courtyard). All rooms have daily cleaning, free Wi-Fi, heating, a smart TV, hair dryer, towels and toiletries, a minibar fridge and a capsule coffee machine. Its site gives walking times of two minutes to the port, five to La Concha beach, eight to the Kursaal and ten to Zurriola. Check-in is 16:00 to 23:00, check-out is before 11:00, pets and smoking are not allowed, and the whole house can be rented. Licence HSS00620.

properties.address: Uba Bidea, 43, 20014 Donostia / San Sebastián, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Uba Hostel is in a green, wooded part of San Sebastián at Camino Uba 43, about 3 km from the centre and roughly 25 minutes away by public transport. It has private and shared rooms, all with their own bathroom, and it is pet friendly. Guests share a kitchen and dining room and can use a large garden, a small sports court, a bar-snack stop called Otxoki, a vending machine, a TV area, luggage storage and Wi-Fi. Some rooms are adapted, and the hostel offers tourist information on the city and the province. Groups of 12 or more can ask for special rates when booking direct. The hostel is run as an inclusive-employment project and is registered as a tourist establishment (BSS00005). Its site links to Bilbao Hostel and a Bilbao caravan park as sister projects. It suits travellers who prefer nature and space to a central location and don't mind the commute into town.

properties.name: ZARAUTZ SURF HOUSE
properties.address: Nafarroa Kalea, 10, 20800 Zarautz, Gipuzkoa
properties.info: Zarautz Surf House is a surf house and surf camp at Nafarroa Kalea 10 in Zarautz, in a villa built in the 1860s and fully renovated with high-quality ecological materials. It combines a hostel-style stay with a surf school for all levels, board and wetsuit rental, and week-long surf camps, taught by a team it describes as instructors with a direct link to surfing. The house also has its own café, Kafe Zarautz Brunch, serving coffee, bowls and brunch after a session, and a small shop selling surfboards, clothing and skateboards. Rooms and surf camps are booked through its website, which also sells lessons and rentals online, and the team can be reached by phone or email. It is registered as a tourist establishment (BSS00038). It suits travellers who want to learn to surf, rather than simply find a cheap bed.

properties.name: ALL IRON HOSTEL
properties.address: Ugarteburu Jose Maria Kalea, 2, 48007 Bilbao, Bizkaia
properties.info: All Iron Hostel sits on the Artagan hill in Bilbao, near the Basilica of Begoña, on the old northern route of the Camino de Santiago and about eight minutes from the Casco Viejo. The name nods to the iron mining that shaped the city in the nineteenth century. It has shared rooms for 4, 6, 8 and 10 people, a room set aside for pilgrims, a female-only room and an adapted room, all facing outside, as well as private rooms. Stays include breakfast, bed linen, Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception, coffee and herbal tea all day, luggage storage, tourist information and air conditioning. Guests can also use a fully equipped kitchen, a games lounge and a terrace with panoramic views of Bilbao, and the team organises social activities such as game nights and tours. Laundry and towel rental cost extra. Groups of more than 50 get special rates, with free parking for cars and coaches.

properties.info: Bilbao Metropolitan Hostel is at Calle Nicolás Alcorta 2, ground floor, run by the Bossh Hotels group. It was recently renovated and has just 11 rooms, all with a private bathroom, air conditioning, soundproofing, a flat-screen TV and a hair dryer, with gel and shampoo provided. Guests share a community kitchen, and there is a washer and dryer, luggage storage, home-automation key access and extra beds on request. No breakfast is served, but the kitchen and fridge are there for your own supplies, and there is no bar, restaurant or private parking, though reception can suggest nearby car parks. Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is until 11:00, with reception open until 23:30 and the building accessible round the clock after online check-in. The Old Town and the Guggenheim Museum are each about a 15-minute walk away. Pets are not allowed.

properties.name: BYPILLOW SAN MAMÉS
properties.address: Luis Briñas K., 15, Basurtu-Zorrotza, 48013 Bilbao, Bizkaia
properties.info: BYPILLOW San Mamés is a recently renovated boutique pension at Calle Luis Briñas 15, beside the San Mamés football stadium and the Termibus bus station, with the San Mamés metro stop close by. It offers private rooms only: singles, doubles, twins and triples, with superior doubles for extra comfort. Every room has air conditioning and an empty mini fridge for guests' own use, and there is free Wi-Fi throughout, daily cleaning, a lift, free luggage storage and multilingual reception staff. Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is at 12:00, with reception open from 14:00 to 06:00. Breakfast is not offered, a refundable 100 euro damage deposit is taken on arrival, and late check-out costs extra. The Guggenheim is about 15 minutes away on foot, the city centre is 1.1 km away and the airport is about 30 minutes by public transport. It suits couples, business travellers and anyone wanting a private room rather than a dorm.

properties.address: Barrio Arce, 1, 48191 Arenao, Bizkaia
properties.info: Caserío Areitz Soroa is a rural farmhouse and albergue at Barrio Artze 1 in Galdames, in the Encartaciones valleys of western Bizkaia, away from Bilbao and the coast. Its site says the whole farmhouse is rented as one unit, in a peaceful setting surrounded by valleys and mountains. It is also an organic farming and gardening centre, with courses in organic horticulture, a shop selling plants and organic vegetables, and a blog, so guests can get involved in the working side of the place if they wish. The hostel's website shows two mobile numbers and a WhatsApp icon, and bookings are taken by phone, as it asks guests to call to reserve. This is a place for a quiet rural stay rather than a city hostel, and it suits groups who want a whole house to themselves.

properties.info: Hostel Quartier Bilbao is a boutique hostel at Artekale 15 in the Casco Viejo, the old quarter of Bilbao made up of seven medieval streets. Its site puts it a minute from the Ribera market, the river and the Cathedral of Santiago, and it describes the surrounding area as the part of the city with the best atmosphere, with bars, shops and pintxos on the doorstep. Guests get a shared kitchen, shared rooms and free Wi-Fi throughout the building. The team has long worked with large groups and has a page for group travel. Quartier also runs a hostel and an apartment in the centre of León. Booking on its own website comes with a best-price guarantee, and the hostel is registered under licence BBI0019.

properties.address: Górdoniz 66, Errekalde (Plaza interior trasera-entrada por, Altube Kalea, 2, Errekalde, 48002 Bilbao, Bizkaia
properties.info: Lamia BBK Women Hostel is a hostel exclusively for women, which it says is the only one in Bilbao. It is at Calle Gordóniz 66, in an inner courtyard with the entrance on Altube 2, in the Rekalde district, a short walk from the Intermodal station and about 15 minutes on foot from the San Mamés stadium. The Guggenheim is 15 minutes away by bus, the Old Town 30 minutes on foot, Abando station 10 minutes by bus and the airport 30 minutes by bus. It has shared rooms for up to 12, a shared four-bed room, a shared double and, with private bathrooms, an adapted double and a superior quad. Every room has lockers, a personal door code, Wi-Fi, heating and air conditioning, and guests share a kitchen and common areas. Check-in is automatic. The hostel runs community, wellness and cultural activities for guests and describes itself as a meeting point for women travelling solo, with friends or in groups.

properties.name: LATROUPE LA GRANJA
properties.address: Plaza Biribila, 3, Abando, 48001 Bilbao, Bizkaia
properties.info: Latroupe La Granja is a boutique hostel at Plaza Circular 3 in the Abando district of central Bilbao, with a bar in the basement that hosts daily events for guests. It has private rooms for two and family rooms for three or four, and shared rooms for four, five, six or eight people, all with private bathrooms. Bed linen and free Wi-Fi are included, towels can be rented for three euros in the shared rooms, and breakfast is served from 08:00 to 11:00. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, luggage storage, a laundry, coworking spaces, a lobby and a guest kitchen in a multipurpose room called El Txoko. Check-in is from 15:30 and check-out is at 11:00. Groups of 13 or more can request a booking through an online form. Guests praise the central position, with the metro opposite, the friendly staff and the lively bar. It is part of the Latroupe group of boutique hostels, which also has hostels in Madrid, Barcelona, Brussels and Dublin.

properties.name: MOANA ECO SURF HOUSE
properties.address: Martxoak 8 kalea, casa 4, 48600 Ugeraga, Bizkaia
properties.info: Moana Eco Surf House is in Sopela, on the Bizkaia coast north of Bilbao, about 400 metres from the beach, at Martxoak 8 Kalea. It is more of a surf resort than a dorm hostel: 11 double rooms, 6 family rooms and 6 group rooms, all with private bathrooms, plus a spa with jacuzzi, sauna and cold plunge, terraces and chill-out areas, hammocks, a garden, skate ramps, a multipurpose dome for yoga and an underground garage for guests. The surf bar serves healthy food. It is the base of the Salbaje Surf Eskola, described as the first surf school on Barinatxe beach, with local qualified instructors, and guests can join free guided yoga classes. Offers combine accommodation with surf courses, surf camps, yoga retreats and group packages. The house promotes an eco concept and a marine plastics project, and it is registered as BBI00052. Phone, mobile and email are listed on its site.

properties.name: OPTIMI ROOMS BILBAO
properties.address: C, Areiltza Doktorearen Zumarkalea, 58, Bajo, Abando, 48010 Bilbao, Bizkaia
properties.info: Optimi Rooms is a capsule hostel at Calle Doctor Areilza 58, ground floor, in the centre of Bilbao, and its site calls it the first capsule hostel in the city. The idea is a new concept of rest at a reduced price: a private sleeping capsule rather than a bunk in an open dorm. The same company runs a second Optimi Rooms hostel in Madrid, and the website lists separate phone numbers and email addresses for each. The Bilbao hostel is registered under BBI00043. The website itself gives few details about facilities, so check the Booking.com and Hostelworld listings for room types, rates and recent guest reviews before you book. Contact is by phone on the Bilbao landline or by email, and the hostel is on Facebook and Instagram.

properties.address: Heros Kalea, 7, Abando, 48009 Bilbao, Bizkaia
properties.info: Poshtel Bilbao calls itself the first premium hostel in Bilbao, at Calle Heros 7, and says it is 50 metres from the Guggenheim Museum while still within reach of the Old Town, the Gran Vía, San Mamés stadium and the river. The idea is a hostel with boutique-hotel touches: you can share a room in a bunk bed or book a private room for yourself and friends, in design-led rooms with free, fast Wi-Fi, a programme of activities and what it calls red-carpet service. Txío, a bar-restaurant, is part of the same venture. Some pet-friendly rooms can be booked on request, and groups of more than ten are asked to contact the hostel by form. It also features in a San Miguel advert with Athletic Club. It is registered as BBI0024, and bookings go through its own online booking engine. Phone and a contact form are on its site; there is no email address listed.

Its site describes it as a hotel with history and internationally recognised decoration, and it makes the city easy to explore on foot: the railway station, the University of the Basque Country and the tourist office are all about 300 metres away, and the Parlamento tram stop is nearby, with a seven-minute connection to the bus station. Next door is the Amárica car park, where guests can ask reception for a voucher to get a special rate, paid on arrival. The hotel offers free high-quality Wi-Fi and promotes itself as a green hotel, with responsible use of water and LED lighting. Booking on its own website gets what it calls the best online rates. It suits travellers who want a private room in Vitoria rather than a dorm bed, and it is registered under licence HVI00331.

It is aimed at groups, sports teams, families, companies and schools as well as individual travellers, and two bus lines stop at its door, which is how guests reach the centre. Beyond nightly stays it also offers a long-stay or coliving option, catering and hospitality services, tourist information on Bilbao and Bizkaia, and a motorhome area run by the same team. It describes itself as a social project, with an inclusive-employment scheme, names the association Suspergintza Elkartea as the organisation behind it, and credits the Basque Government's tourism department for support. It is registered as a tourist establishment (BBI00014) and is linked on its site to Uba Hostel in San Sebastián. It suits groups and budget travellers who value space and a social mission more than a central location.

properties.address: Rúa Maior, 79, 27600 Sarria, Lugo
properties.info: This is the public pilgrims’ albergue in Sarria, run by the Xunta de Galicia in an old stone house on the town’s main street, Rúa Maior. It is for pilgrims only, so you need a pilgrim credential (credencial). Beds cannot be reserved: it is first come, first served, and with 40 places in a single dormitory it can fill early when walkers finishing a stage arrive at the same time as those starting their Camino here. It is open all year, from 13:00 until it closes at 22:00, though hours can change, so check locally. There is a kitchen (without utensils) with a microwave, a washing machine and dryer, and disposable sheets, and the building is accessible to guests with reduced mobility.

properties.address: C/Andrés del Rio, P.º Canalejas, nº 7, 39004 Santander, Cantabria
properties.info: Enjoy Santander is a hostel on the ground floor at Calle Andrés del Río 7, a few minutes on foot from the city's beaches and its most popular area for bars and restaurants. Rooms are shared dorms with large shared bathrooms, plus a single room with a private bathroom. Guests describe curtained bunk cabins with their own light and a power socket with USB, and big lockers under the beds. Bedding and shower gel are included in the price, there is free Wi-Fi, and every room has heating. The common area has a fridge, dishwasher, microwave, toaster, coffee machine and crockery. Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is at 11:00. Pilgrims walking the Camino de Santiago have stayed here and praise how comfortable it feels after a run of basic albergues. From the centre you can follow the bay all the way to the Cabo Mayor lighthouse, passing a string of beaches.

properties.name: HOSTEL SANTANDER
properties.address: 1B, P.º de Pereda, 15, 39004 Santander, Cantabria
properties.info: Hostel Santander is a budget hostel on the first floor at Paseo de Pereda 15, in the centre of Santander. It offers shared rooms, and recent guests mention four power sockets by each bed, two of them USB, a personal locker and a bathroom for each room. The shared lounge looks out over the street and has a small enclosed terrace, and older reviews mention sea views from it. The staff and owner are repeatedly praised for being friendly and for helping with tips on where to eat, surf and go out. The beach is a short walk away. The hostel's website promotes day trips to Comillas and Potes, the Camino del Norte and the Camino Lebaniego, and the countryside around Santander, and it presents itself as an economical, comfortable base for travellers passing through. It says booking directly on its own site gets the best prices, and it takes guests from all over the world.

properties.name: HOSTEL VILLA MIGUELA
properties.address: P.º Menéndez Pelayo, 66, 39006 Santander, Cantabria
properties.info: Hostel Villa Miguela is a small hostel that opened in 2022 in a house with a garden at Paseo Menéndez Pelayo 66, in a residential part of Santander a few metres from Calle Tetuán and Calle Peñarbosa, two restaurant areas. The garden, shared lounge and terrace are open to guests, and free Wi-Fi covers the whole property. Beds are in bunk pods that give some privacy, and guests describe the hostel as very clean and comfortable with friendly staff, although a few find it quiet. The kitchen is basic, with a microwave and toaster but no hob, so don't plan on cooking pasta. Check-in starts at 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Breakfast is not included, guests must be 18 or over, and pets are not allowed. The nearest beaches are the El Sardinero beaches, and Santander airport is about 9 km away.

properties.name: HOTEL BOUTIQUE LAS BRISAS
properties.address: C. la Braña, 14, 39005 Santander, Cantabria
properties.info: Hotel Boutique Las Brisas is a small hotel directly facing the Sardinero beach in Santander, at Calle La Braña 14. It describes itself as combining contemporary luxury with the elegant, classic character of a stately residence, so this is a private-room hotel rather than a dorm hostel. Alongside the hotel rooms it runs modern one- and two-bedroom apartments for longer stays, and it lists deluxe suites for two or three people, with a private pool and barbecue area, as coming soon. Breakfast is included when you book online through the hotel's own site, parking on the surrounding street is free, and pets are accepted in the apartments. The Sardinero is lined with gardens, seafront promenades and historic buildings, with restaurants, cafés and bars close by serving local fish and seafood. It suits couples and anyone who wants to wake up facing the beach.

properties.name: ALBERG BANYOLES
properties.address: Carrer Migdia, 10, 17820 Banyoles, Girona
properties.info: Alberg de Banyoles is a tourist hostel at Carrer del Migdia 10 in the urban centre of Banyoles, in the Pla de l'Estany, aimed mainly at school groups, sports teams and families. Its site says the central position is ideal for sports stays in canoeing, swimming and rowing, with good access to Banyoles lake and the facilities of the Club Natació Banyoles, as well as excursions and activities for school classes and families. There are more than ten rooms with bathrooms for four to six people, and stays are on a full-board basis with educational, sporting and cultural activities. Families can combine a stay with a free guided visit and discount coupons for local activities. The Girona to Banyoles to Serinyà greenway, nearly 40 km of the Tren Pinxo route, is a new cycling option on the doorstep. A virtual tour of the hostel is on its website. Phone, email, Facebook and Instagram are listed in the footer.

properties.name: ALBERG COSTA BRAVA
properties.address: Carrer Setcases, 9, 17490 Llançà, Girona
properties.info: Alberg Costa Brava is a hostel at Carrer Setcases 9 in Llançà, near the beach in the Cap de Creus area, with double rooms, family rooms and group stays. A team of four opened it more than ten years ago as a refuge for walkers, cyclists, kayakers and nature lovers, and it belongs to the Hostelling International and Costa Brava Pirineu hostel networks. Breakfast uses local km0 products such as bread from a local bakery, there are inclusive toilets, and guests are asked to help recycle and cut energy, water and plastic use. Walks from the area include stage one of the GR92 coastal path from Portbou to Llançà, a six-hour stage on to Cadaqués, and Sant Pere de Rodes. The Dalí museum in Figueres, Cadaqués and Cap de Creus are all within reach, and trains and buses link Llançà with Barcelona. Contact is by phone, email, Facebook and Instagram.

properties.name: ALBERG LA MOLINA XANASCAT
properties.address: Plaça del Sitjar, 1, 17537 La Molina, Girona, Girona
properties.info: La Molina Xanascat is a mountain hostel at 1,450 metres in the municipality of Alp, in the Cerdanya, built in stone and wood to blend into its surroundings. It is five minutes from the La Molina ski slopes, 15 from La Masella and about 25 from French resorts such as Font-Romeu, and Puigcerdà, the capital of the Cerdanya, is close. In winter it is a base for skiing and other mountain sports, and nearby you can hike in the Cadí-Moixeró Natural Park, visit the Martinet bunkers, see animals at a farm in Prullans or tour local food producers. Local events include the Trinxat festival in Puigcerdà in February and an accordion meeting at La Molina in August. It belongs to the Xanascat network of Catalan youth hostels, which mostly serves school and youth groups; reservations go through the network's central office or online.

properties.name: ALBERG PLANOLES XANASCAT
properties.address: Ctra Nevà Prat Cap Riu, s/n, 17535 Planoles, Girona
properties.info: Planoles Xanascat is a mountain hostel beside the village of Planoles, on the Rigard river in the Ribes valleys of the Ripollès, surrounded by woods, paths and mountain villages. It has 194 places and was the first hostel the Generalitat of Catalonia inaugurated as such, a mountain building for staying comfortably for a few days. Walks and hikes start from the door, peaks above 2,000 metres are within easy reach, and the ski resorts of La Molina and La Masella, the north of the Berguedà and the Cerdanya are all close, with adventure sports and fishing for those who want them. Above all, the hostel sells peace and quiet. It belongs to the Xanascat network of Catalan youth hostels and can be contacted directly or through the network's central reservations office.

properties.address: Passeig Doctor Ariet, 6, 17406 Viladrau, Girona
properties.info: Cubez Hostel Viladrau is a hostel in the village of Viladrau, in the heart of the Montseny, surrounded by the Montseny Natural Park and the Guilleries range and about an hour from Barcelona. Its site pitches it as a base for nature lovers and adventurers, with seasonal activities through the year. Rooms range from singles and twins to triples and quads, including a four-bed bunk room, and there is a dining room serving a breakfast buffet and a dinner menu. Guests can hire mountain bikes and quad bikes, borrow mushroom-picking baskets, and use a barbecue pit and a bonfire area. Groups can request a quote for stays with meals, bike hire, hiking gear and picnic lunches. Bookings go through its website, and guests can contact the hostel by phone, WhatsApp or email.

properties.address: Carrer de l'Església, 6, 17488 Cadaqués, Girona
properties.info: Hostal Vehí is a family-run hostal at Carrer de l'Església 6, in the centre of Cadaqués, beside the church of Santa María and a few metres from the beach. The building dates from 1944, when it was a fonda, an inn, and later a restaurant, and it now offers private rooms only: a 12 square metre single, a 12 square metre double with one or two beds, and an 18 square metre triple with three single beds. Rooms have private bathrooms, air conditioning and, depending on the room, heating, cable or flat-screen TV, a safe and a hairdryer, and the hostal has free Wi-Fi. Its site promises free cancellation up to 72 hours before arrival and the best price when you book direct. Cadaqués is called the most charming village on the Costa Brava, and the hostal is within walking distance of its stone lanes. Guests can contact the hostal by phone, WhatsApp or email.

properties.name: HOTEL L'ILLA
properties.address: Carrer Nou, 35, 17320 Tossa de Mar, Girona
properties.info: L'Illa Hotel is a small, simple hotel at Carrer Nou 35 in the centre of Tossa de Mar, a few minutes from the old town and about five minutes on foot from the beach. Its rooms were renovated in 2025 and are cleaned daily; singles have a window or inner balcony, and doubles and triples have inner or outer balconies. All have a private bathroom, a TV and heating and cooling, and Wi-Fi covers the whole building. Parking is available with limited spaces, so ask on arrival. Breakfast is not served, but the team recommends places nearby. The owner pitches it as a straightforward place to rest after a day exploring Tossa, with a personal welcome, and guest reviews on its site single out the helpful staff, the cleanliness and the location. The hotel also lists shared rooms on a separate page of its website. Booking direct through the site is promised to be the cheapest option.

properties.name: HOTEL SALLÉS AEROPORT GIRONA
properties.address: N-156, Km. 0,6, 17457 Riudellots de la Selva, Girona
properties.info: Hotel Sallés Aeroport Girona is a hotel, not a hostel, on the Nacional 156 road at kilometre 0.6 in Riudellots de la Selva, five minutes from Girona-Costa Brava airport and 15 minutes from Girona's old town, and about 45 minutes from both Barcelona and the French border. It sells itself as a minimalist stopover for travellers who enjoy the journey. Rooms are doubles and triples, and day-use rooms are also offered for a rest between flights. There is free parking, a large outdoor pool and garden, a restaurant called Empordà serving traditional Catalan food with modern touches and local produce, and a 400 square metre spa with a heated pool, jacuzzi, sensory showers and massage rooms that is open to non-guests too. Guests who book on the hotel's own website are promised the best price, early check-in and late check-out, a welcome drink and free spa access. It has meeting rooms for business groups.

properties.name: MANÀ MANÀ HOSTEL
properties.address: Carrer de Sant Telm, 9, 17320 Tossa de Mar, Girona
properties.info: Mana Mana is a youth hostel at Carrer de Sant Telm 9 in Tossa de Mar, about 40 metres from the beach and inside the only fortified medieval town still standing on the Catalan coast. It has beds in a six-bed mixed dorm, a four-bed female dorm and a four- or five-bed mixed room with a private bathroom. The hostel's rooftop terrace has a bar and food service and views over the town, and guests often mention the family dinners held there on many evenings and the mix of nationalities. Sheets and blankets, free Wi-Fi, a shared kitchen and luggage storage are included. Walking the Camí de Ronda coast path, diving and snorkelling, and the town's cultural calendar are the main activities it suggests. It carries a solo-female-friendly badge and belongs to a group of independent European hostels, and reviewers repeatedly praise the owner, Pablo, the cleanliness and the location.

properties.address: Av. Palfuriana, 104, 43880 Coma-ruga, Tarragona
properties.info: Coma-ruga Xanascat is a seaside hostel at Avinguda Palfuriana 104 in Coma-ruga, part of the municipality of El Vendrell in the Baix Penedès, built long ago to host children on holiday. Xanascat sums the area up as the Mediterranean: culture, sport, thermal waters and a long beach. El Vendrell has several museums and foundations and stages cultural events, above all concerts, both in the town centre and in the seafront district. Hostel routines are posted: dinner is served from 20:30 to 21:00 and silence begins at midnight, with other times available at the hostel. It belongs to the Xanascat network of Catalan youth hostels, which mostly serves school and youth groups; reservations go through the network's central office or online.

properties.address: Avinguda de les Goles de l'Ebre, s/n, 43580 Deltebre, Tarragona
properties.info: Deltebre Xanascat is a youth hostel on Avinguda de les Goles de l'Ebre in Deltebre, which Xanascat describes as being in the heart of the Ebro Delta Nature Park, a prime spot for experiencing nature. It is one of the hostels of the Xanascat network run by the Catalan Government, which mostly serves school and youth groups, and reservations go through the network's central office or online. Check rooms, facilities and opening dates with the hostel or the central reservations office before you plan a stay.

properties.name: ALBERG XERTA
properties.address: Carrer Major, 63, 43592 Xerta, Tarragona
properties.info: Alberg Xerta is a hostel at Carrer Major 63 in the village of Xerta, in the Terres de l'Ebre, which describes itself as an eco-responsible refuge set in the heart of nature. It has five rooms with 50 beds and is open all year. Its main business is stays for school groups, with programmes for primary and secondary classes combining adventure activities, workshops on local fauna and flora, walks and visits to learn about the local culture, but it also takes families, groups of friends and individual travellers, and the whole hostel can be rented. A virtual tour of the building is on its website. The hostel is run by the company Viurenviu, SL, and its website shows an email address and a mobile number for enquiries. It suits groups and small parties better than a traveller looking for a bed in a social dorm.

properties.name: CASA ROMA HOSTEL BOUTIQUE
properties.address: Av. de Roma, 32, 43005 Tarragona
properties.info: Casa Roma Hostel Boutique is a design-led hostel at Avinguda de Roma 32 in Tarragona, with a Mediterranean feel and a tourist licence number of HT-005106-46. It offers private rooms only: elegant doubles, family rooms with bunk beds and spacious quads, all with private bathrooms, plenty of natural light and a quiet setting. There are generous common areas for working, relaxing and sharing meals, a restaurant serving creative, local, seasonal Mediterranean food from breakfast to dinner, self-service laundry, electric bikes to rent for exploring the city and its beaches, and access to parking. Two meeting and event spaces, Barcino and Tarraco, are available to hire, and the hostel welcomes sports, corporate and school groups with tailored stays. The young team describes its approach as warm and attentive. It is a good base for seeing Roman Tarragona at a calm pace. Guests contact the hostel by phone or email.

properties.name: HOSTAL FORUM TARRAGONA
properties.address: Plaça de la Font, 37, 43003 Tarragona
properties.info: Hostal Forum Tarragona is at Plaça de la Font 37 in the centre of Tarragona, in a building that stands on the old tiers of the Roman circus of Tarraco, so guests sleep literally on top of the cavea where thousands once watched the games. It offers shared rooms with bunk beds and exposed stone walls, and private rooms with a private bathroom, some with a small balcony over the square. Rooms have air conditioning and fast free Wi-Fi, and guests can use a dining area with a fridge, microwave and long table, a coffee corner with free drinking water and a work space. Check-in is automatic around the clock through a touch-screen kiosk and key dispenser, with check-in from 14:00 and check-out at 11:00. Smoking is not allowed and parking is paid. Guest reviews praise the location, cleanliness and value, though several note that rooms are small. It is registered under licence HT-000115.

properties.name: HOTEL BON LLOC
properties.address: Carretera Vinaròs, s/n, 43550 Ulldecona, Tarragona
properties.info: Hotel Bon Lloc is a rustic family hotel, not a hostel, on the Carretera de Vinaròs in Ulldecona, in the south of Tarragona province, run since 1974. It sits in a quiet setting away from the bustle of the town but close enough to reach the local sights, which include Ulldecona castle, the old town, the cave paintings and the Ermita de la Pietat, with the Ebro delta and the Ports de Beseit mountains further afield. Rooms range from singles and doubles to a quadruple, an apartment and a deluxe suite, and guests have free Wi-Fi, free parking in front of the hotel around the clock, a secure bike store and all-day access to the swimming pool. Check-in is from 16:00 to 21:00, check-out is at noon, and guests can come and go at any hour. The restaurant serves a daily menu using local produce. It suits drivers and cyclists looking for a quiet private room, not backpackers in dorms.

properties.address: Carrer de la Unió, 26, 43001 Tarragona
properties.info: Tarragona Hostel is a social hostel at Carrer de la Unió 26 in the centre of Tarragona. Its site says three travellers opened it in 2014 as the city's first hostel, and its aim is to be a meeting point where travellers and locals share experiences. It has shared and private rooms, all with lockers, a fully equipped shared kitchen and common areas for socialising. The bar and café serves breakfast and coffee, vermouth and evening gatherings, and hosts cultural events. The hostel organises excursions and guided routes, rents bicycles and can host private celebrations. Breakfast is included on all bookings from 1 June to 30 September and is an optional extra from 1 October to 31 May. Check-in is from 14:00 until midnight and check-out is until 11:00. It says it suits solo travellers, many of whom make friends in the common areas or on activities. The Roman amphitheatre by the sea and the Rambla Nova are among its suggested sights.

properties.name: AIRHOSTEL BCN
properties.address: Carrer de Narcís Monturiol, 48, 08820 El Prat de Llobregat, Barcelona
properties.info: AirHostel BCN is a hostel at Carrer Narcís Monturiol 48 in El Prat de Llobregat, a few minutes by public transport from Barcelona-El Prat airport, aimed at travellers with stopovers or early flights. It calls its concept lowxury, mixing the social side of a hostel with premium facilities. Shared dorms are mixed or female, with a curtain on every bed, air conditioning and a personal locker, and private rooms are available too. Guests get free Wi-Fi, a kitchen with a microwave, a cafeteria area, a meeting room and a jukebox and vending machine in the common spaces. The metro and buses link El Prat with central Barcelona, from the Sagrada Família and the Ramblas to the Fira trade-fair grounds. Booking on its official website is promised to carry the best price plus an extra 10 per cent discount, and there is a groups page for larger bookings. Phone, email, Facebook and Instagram are listed on the site.

properties.name: ALBERG CABRERA DE MAR XANASCAT
properties.address: Camí de Santa Elena, 34, 08349 Cabrera de Mar, Barcelona
properties.info: Cabrera de Mar Xanascat is a youth hostel at Camí de Santa Elena 34 in Cabrera de Mar, a charming small town in the Maresme surrounded by nature, which Xanascat describes as the most welcoming and captivating part of the Maresme. It is one of the hostels of the Xanascat network run by the Catalan Government, which mostly serves school and youth groups, and it is also one of the network's hostels used for its summer programme. Reservations go through the network's central office or online. Check rooms, facilities and opening dates with the hostel or the central reservations office before you plan a stay.

properties.name: ALBERG CENTRE ESPLAI
properties.address: Carrer del Riu Anoia, 42, 08820 El Prat de Llobregat, Barcelona
properties.info: Alberg Centre Esplai is a hostel at Carrer Riu Anoia 42-54 in El Prat de Llobregat, beside Barcelona airport, run by Fundesplai, a non-profit foundation focused on education and social inclusion. It describes itself as an oasis of nature and comfort that is ecological, accessible and family friendly, and it holds the EMAS and Biosphere sustainability certifications, saving water, recycling and producing green energy. The building is 100 per cent accessible, with private rooms, a restaurant serving a buffet and set menus, a café, a swimming pool, a garden, an auditorium, meeting rooms and a large multi-purpose pavilion, plus parking. Families, school groups, sports clubs, conferences and travellers who care about the environment are its target guests, and past guests praise its closeness to the airport, spacious rooms and a family play area. Contact details, a route guide by public transport and online booking are on its website.

properties.address: Carrer Occident, 69, BAJOS, 08904 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelona

properties.name: HOLA HOSTAL
properties.address: Carrer 11 de Setembre, 11, 08903 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelona
properties.info: Hola Hostel Collblanc is at Carrer 11 de Setembre 11 in the Collblanc district of L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, just outside Barcelona, and is one of two Hola hostels in the area. Its own site describes it as a functional, comfortable, well-located place for organising a trip and enjoying Barcelona and its surroundings with complete freedom. It has a 24-hour reception, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a kitchen and dining area, and shared rooms including a mixed six-person dormitory with lockers and a mix of single and bunk beds. The site promises the best online price and free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival when you book direct, and it is registered with the Catalan youth-hostel registry as number 687. Phone, email, Facebook and Instagram are listed on the Hola Hostel website. Check the Booking.com and Hostelworld listings for rates and recent guest reviews before you book.

properties.name: HOSTELFLY FIRA BARCELONA
properties.address: Carrer d'Enric Morera, 58, 08902 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Barcelona
properties.info: Hostelfly Fira Barcelona is a hostel at Carrer d'Enric Morera 58 in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, next to Gran Via and very close to the Fira Barcelona exhibition grounds, so it works as a convenient base for trade fairs, events, work trips and group getaways as well as city breaks. It describes its offer as shared rooms with a private bathroom, common areas for day-to-day use and services meant to make the stay smooth from arrival. The building has a lift, a lounge and a swimming pool, and it is part of the Hostelfly group, which also runs a hostel near Madrid airport and promotes free cancellation and a best-price guarantee on its own website. Reservations can be made online, and the hostel can be contacted by phone or email. Check the Booking.com and Hostelworld listings for room types, rates and recent guest reviews before you book.

properties.name: MUCHA MASIA HOSTEL RURAL-URBÀ
properties.address: Carrer de Jaume Casanovas, 55, 08820 El Prat de Llobregat, Barcelona
properties.info: Mucha Masia is a hostel at Carrer Jaume Casanovas 55 in El Prat de Llobregat, in one of the few traditional Catalan farmhouses, or masías, still standing in the town centre, with walls more than two centuries old. It is about 15 minutes from the centre of Barcelona and from the airport and is surrounded by the Llobregat Delta and the Parc Agrari. Facilities listed include free Wi-Fi throughout, a 24-hour reception, a kitchen for guests, a large terrace with chill-out areas, free tea, breakfast included, a locker drawer with a key under every bunk and accessibility for all guests. Bikes can be rented to ride to the beach or into the delta nature reserve, and an airport taxi service can be arranged. The Camp Nou stadium is about 25 minutes away on metro line 9. Reviewers praise the friendly staff, who are always on reception, and the relaxed atmosphere. Contact is by phone or email.

properties.name: SALLÉS HOTEL CIUTAT DEL PRAT
properties.address: Avinguda del Remolar, 46, 08820 El Prat de Llobregat, Barcelona
properties.info: Hotel Sallés Ciutat del Prat is a hotel, not a hostel, at Avinguda del Remolar 46 in the centre of El Prat de Llobregat, five minutes from Barcelona airport and 15 minutes from the centre of Barcelona and the port, near the quiet Prat beach. It offers single and double rooms and triples, a heated indoor pool with waterfalls, jets and a sauna, a fitness centre and a restaurant called Sinfonía, where chef Joan Figueres cooks local produce with a creative touch. A free transfer runs from the airport to the hotel and back, and to key places in the town, and free Wi-Fi is included. Guests who book on the hotel's own website are promised early check-in and late check-out, a welcome drink and the best price, and there is a cruise pack for travellers boarding a ship the next day. It belongs to the Sallés Hotels group. It is a convenient private-room stop before a flight rather than a backpacker base.

properties.name: ALBERG LES DAINES
properties.address: Pla de Berrader, s/n, 25597 Espot, Lleida
properties.info: Albergue Les Daines is a mountain hostel at Pla de Berradé in Espot, Lleida, at the foot of the Espot Esquí ski slopes, about 50 metres from the lifts and a kilometre and a half from the village of Espot, the gateway to Aigüestortes i Estany de Sant Maurici National Park. It is open all year. Rooms are never shared between unrelated guests: family rooms for four or five with bunks and single beds and a shared bathroom, and doubles with a shared or private bathroom, and pets are welcome. The bar-restaurant serves home cooking to guests and passers-by, and there is a chill-out area. The hostel can arrange ski school and equipment rental, and the area offers more than 20 km of pistes on 22 runs, plus rafting, canyoning, climbing, mountain biking, horse riding and quad circuits. It suits families, school and scout groups, friends and couples, and is open to walkers heading into the national park.

properties.address: Rúa Encarnación, 30, 15124 Muxía, A Coruña
properties.info: Bela Muxía is a small private albergue in the fishing village of Muxía on the Costa da Morte, at the end of the Fisterra–Muxía Camino. It is about 300 metres from the village centre and a short walk from the beach. Guests have a shared kitchen and lounge, a terrace, free Wi-Fi, laundry, luggage storage, bicycle parking and a tour desk. The interior is themed around the legends, poems and history of Muxía and the Coast of Death, with a small exhibition for guests to read. On Hostelworld it scores a perfect 10 out of 10 from 42 reviews, with every category rated 10.0. Guests praise the hosts, and arriving pilgrims often mention the homemade soup and bread they are offered. Booking.com guests single out the owners and staff, the design, the kitchen, the soup and the location. Breakfast is not included, there is no curfew, and Hostelworld bookings can be cancelled free up to 48 hours before arrival.

properties.name: AREA SURF HOUSE
properties.address: Porto carral, 11, 15291 Muros, A Coruña
properties.info: Area Surf House is a surf hostel on the Muros coast of A Coruña province, roughly a 10–15-minute walk from the beaches of San Francisco and Area Maior-Louro. Beds are in shared dorms, and guests have a shared living area and a dining space with a long table. Air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, laundry service and housekeeping are provided, and there is free private parking, which helps if you are exploring this stretch of coast by car.

properties.name: NÁUTICO DE RAZO
properties.address: Rúa Paseo Praia, 14, 15107 Arnados, A Coruña
properties.info: Hostal Náutico de Razo sits right on Razo beach in the Carballo area of A Coruña province, with direct access to the sand; Baldaio beach is about 15–20 minutes’ walk along the coast. It is closer to a beachfront guesthouse than a dormitory hostel: there are 17 rooms with private bathrooms, a garden, a terrace, an open-air bath and a restaurant serving seafood and local dishes, with free Wi-Fi throughout and a free continental breakfast (9:00–11:00). Guests praise the beach location, the clean rooms and the hosts, and surfers mention good board storage, showers for rinsing off and a wetsuit-drying area. One guest found the restaurant closed during their stay, so check ahead if you are counting on it. There are seven beach bars close by.

properties.name: HOTEL NAUTICO
properties.address: R. de Luis Taboada, 28, 36201 Vigo, Pontevedra
properties.info: Hotel Náutico is a former hotel turned hostel, standing between the marina and the Alameda in central Vigo, a few steps from the old town (Casco Vello) and the Calle Príncipe shopping street. Rooms are either shared or double, and every room has its own private bathroom. Dorm beds have a privacy curtain, a light and a plug socket, and there is a lift, free Wi-Fi, free luggage storage, free city maps and tourist information at the desk. Breakfast is not included. Hostelworld rates it 8.4 out of 10 from 30 reviews: guests score the location (9.7) and staff (9.3) very highly, and one reviewer praised the help with planning onward travel. The weakest score is facilities (6.7). Reviewers mention slow shower drainage and the occasional cleanliness slip, and Hostelworld’s summary of guest feedback says it often feels more like a hotel than a social hostel. In-person reception is open 08:00–21:00, with check-in from 15:00.
